note: The script asks for the question as hook text, one name super, three top text lines and a key-words stack, so 6 graphics and the end card. Rows 00:25–00:30 and 00:30–00:34 are captions only. The CASS logo file is not in endcards/ yet, so the end card types CASS until it is added.

mg.title: Hook question

text.main: You had to choose between medicine and food?

mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1: You had to choose between medicine and food? Already on screen at 0:00. Does not animate on.
mg.use: Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:03. Top third.

mg.title: Name super
mg.cue: Name super at 00:04 for 3 s, lower left above the captions: Barbara / Resident, The Haven.
mg.use: Put it on at 00:04 for 3 s. Move it lower left, above the captions. Type the second line Resident, The Haven under the name.

mg.title: Top text
mg.cue: Top text at 00:12 for 2 s, top band, as she says it: Everybody has a story.
mg.use: Put it on at 00:12 as she says it. Top band. Keep captions on.

mg.title: Key words
mg.cue: Key words at 00:21, stacked in the top band as she says them: They lost their home / medical issues / different stories.
mg.use: Start at 00:21 so each phrase lands as she says it. Top band. Keep captions on.

mg.title: Top text

text.main: I've been blessed with this place helping me

mg.cue: Top text at 00:38 for 2.5 s, top band, as she says it: I've been blessed with this place helping me.
mg.use: Put it on at 00:38 as she says it. Top band.

mg.title: Top text

text.main: Don't give up because there is help out there.

mg.cue: Top text at 00:44 for 3 s, top band, as she says it: Don't give up because there is help out there.
mg.use: Put it on at 00:44 as she says it. Top band. Keep captions on.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: End card: CASS logo, then the line For more information visit cassaz.org.
mg.src: No CASS end card or logo file is in the repo yet (endcards/index.json has no CASS entry, checked 3 Nov 2026), so CASS is typed. Line from the script's end card row (cassaz.org, the CASS end card line in the client file); colours from the CASS brand (navy #2C2B77, white).
mg.use: After the last line at 00:48. Hold it to the end. Swap in the CASS logo once it is in the repo.
